`eld-480.bin` and `eld-512.bin` contain 64 stereo AAC-ELD packets each, at
44.1 kHz and 128 kbit/s. Each packet is prefixed by its four-byte big-endian
length. Input is an unprotected 440/880 Hz sine pair generated by
`tools/generate_eld_fixtures.cpp`, using the independently implemented FDK-AAC
encoder (SBR disabled, RAW transport). No recorded device or copyrighted media
is included. FDK-AAC is a fixture generation tool, not an application dependency.

Regenerate with the generator linked against FDK-AAC, passing `480` or `512`
and the respective output filename. The test checks decoded sample counts,
signal content, duplicates, encrypted UDP delivery and sequence wrap.


`alac-{10,20,30,50,55,60,99}.bin` contains synthetic constant stereo i16 PCM
(352 frames, indicated sample value) encoded by system FFmpeg's ALAC encoder;
only the MP4 `mdat` packet is retained. This supports RTP recovery tests without
including an encoder in the application dependency graph.

`media/` contains synthetic H.264/HEVC test-pattern MP4 files at 128x96 and
96x128, 30 frames each, plus independent ffprobe packet/extradata sidecars.
`media/hls/` contains one-second HLS TS and fragmented MP4 inputs with a sine
track. `media/sha256.json` pins fixture contents. The integration harness checks
these hashes before using them; it never invokes runtime encoders.

Regeneration uses an external system FFmpeg/ffprobe (not the packaged DLLs):
H.264/HEVC `testsrc2=size=128x96:rate=30` / `testsrc2=size=96x128:rate=30`,
`-frames:v 30 -c:v libx264` / `-c:v libx265`, and JSON ffprobe
`-show_packets -show_streams -show_data`. HLS uses one-second testsrc2 and a
44.1 kHz sine, libx264/AAC, `-f hls -hls_time 1`, selecting
`-hls_segment_type mpegts` or `fmp4`. Encoders remain outside the application.
Regenerated bytes may differ across generator versions; refresh hashes and
review signal/packet invariants explicitly rather than accepting silent changes.

`media/hevc-main10-{sdr,pq,hlg}.mp4` and their packet sidecars exercise actual
Main10 decoding and colour metadata. PQ has BT.2020 primaries, ST 2084 transfer,
1000-nit mastering metadata and MaxCLL 800; HLG uses BT.2020/BT.2100 transfer.
`media/hls-{pq,hlg}` are matching HEVC/AAC fMP4 playlists. Regenerate explicitly
with `tools/generate_10bit_fixtures.py`, using external FFmpeg/libx265 and ffprobe.
`main10-generator.json` records the generator version. x265 is a test fixture
generator only; it is not a receiver dependency or packaged encoder.

`crypto-vectors.txt` contains 256 deterministic cipher known-answer cases,
64 for each mode. `tools/rust_crypto_vectors.py` verifies the Rust implementation
against the fixed expected bytes, without requiring another implementation at
build or test time.
